For solo service businesses

Run your bookings and your books, without the spreadsheet.

GigDesk is a simple, offline-first scheduling and earnings tracker built for hairstylists, tutors, repair techs, and anyone else who runs their own calendar and their own accounts.

Get GigDesk Free · Android · No account required

Everything a one-person business needs to run its day

Not a stripped-down version of enterprise software — built from the ground up for someone managing their own schedule and their own accounts.

Bookings & calendar

Day, week, and month views. Create a booking in seconds with customer, service, and price pre-filled. Add it to your phone's calendar with one tap.

Payments & accounts

Record full or partial payments against any booking, track what's owed at a glance, and manage your own payment accounts — cash, GCash, bank transfer, and more.

Earnings & reports

See today's bookings and this month's earnings the moment you open the app. Profit & Loss and outstanding-balance reports, exportable as PDF.

Customers

A simple customer list with contact details and booking history. Import a new customer straight from your phone's contacts, one at a time.

Privacy-minded backup

Optional Google Drive backup using the narrowest permission available — GigDesk can only ever see the one folder it creates. Nothing required to use the app day to day.

Expenses

Log business expenses by category and account, so you always see real profit — not just revenue.
